findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: shipcheck_scan, get_fix · Private data: shipcheck_scan, get_fix · Public sink: shipcheck_scan, get_fix.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: shipcheck_scan, get_fix · Private data: shipcheck_scan, get_fix · Public sink: shipcheck_scan, get_fix

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
